optimized_engine.canonicalizer: natural-order minimum-word fibre; exact pair-orbit size = word-orbit size times distinct multiplier images in the minimum-word fibre

prefix8.hold_reason: Mathematically blocked: raw top map T is not the required A24_rel=T|ker(L); no lower-map kernel restriction or exact lower-correction certificate is present. Resource clearance alone is insufficient.
acceptance: fail-closed bounded-result schema accepts no extra/missing fields and exact interval [0,8]
full TSV hashes, strict sorting, counts, U24 lattice, and every H-orbit division replay
all 257 distributed literal columns lie in the provider orbit, equal its natural-order minimum, and have the exact orbit size
top fan 60, terminality, mass, charge, and self-pairing assertions hold
actual wall, peak family RSS, aggregate RSS, and retained bytes satisfy every hard gate
manifest is sealed before any intermediate cleanup

restartable_full_schedule_if_prefix8_pas.source_coverage_rule: 61 no-gap non-overlapping intervals [8*j,min(8*(j+1),485)) for integer j=0,...,60

merge.inputs_per_group: the strict compact/<group>/final.bin from every independently accepted shard
merge.algorithm: restartable sorted k-way exact merge by 21-byte canonical column; assert identical orbit size, sum i128 orbit-total masses, drop only exact zeros
merge.ledger_guards: exact 61-interval bitset, no gap/overlap, common source/input/engine hashes, strict two-group/13-ID coverage, exact full pivot counts
merge.derived_checks: regenerate separate group TSVs, exact W/orbit division, 60-output terminal fan and charge on demand, total row mass = 60 times column mass
merge.atomic_outputs: two global compact binaries, two TSVs, strict result JSON, shard-hash ledger, witness ledger, manifest
merge.forbidden: no K24 row materialization and no scalar-only substitution

disk_lifecycle.before_independent_acceptance: retain raw/, raw_compact/, canonical/, compact/, both TSVs, result, witnesses, and hashes
disk_lifecycle.after_independent_acceptance: delete only that shard's validated raw/, raw_compact/, and canonical/ trees; retain compact/final.bin for both groups, both TSVs, result.json, literal_witnesses.tsv, validation transcript, and hashes
disk_lifecycle.after_global_merge_acceptance: shard cores remain retained unless a separate destructive-cleanup authorization names exact shard paths

fallback_if_prefix8_fails.condition: a production-engine revision must fail-closed on exactly those intervals; the current --production-shard list still encodes the superseded 60/61-record geometry and must not be used
fallback_if_prefix8_fails.cleanup_and_merge: identical acceptance, lifecycle, and exact merge rules

acceptable_supersession: source-faithful relative-column producer restricting top columns to ker(L)
exact independently checked lower-correction certificate for every retained top column

scope: Design and bounded prefix only; no prefix8, production shard, full merge, K24 span, or conjecture claim.
